description: Shadow-ICP trigger fires on realized value

input.records: 3 deprioritized-industry accounts carry shadow_icp_flag; 2 of them have a positive Value Bridge realization on record

expected_behavior: Shadow ICP section leads with the fired trigger: 2+ realized-value accounts from one emergent segment; the finding is routed to the next ICP redefinition (icp-drift-monitor / Step 9) explicitly. The third account is listed as supporting evidence. No ICP change is made by the agent.

description: Small-N cluster stays a watch item

input.records: 1 flagged account in a new vertical, no realization yet

expected_behavior: Listed under watch items with count 1 and the literal label 'small-N: watch, do not act'. No routing fires. If the same item has appeared before, its consecutive-months count is shown rather than re-alarming as new.

description: Gate calibration: prediction vs outcome divergence

input.records: Account X: sale-quality-review predicted FM-C exposure at close; churn-analysis later classified the churn FM-B

expected_behavior: FM trend section reports the divergence for Account X with both sources cited and dates; states it as calibration input for the good-sale-gate rubric, picks neither record as the truth, and executes nothing.
